verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a first-party Zapier integration that uses its webhooks to automatically fetch transcripts when meetings are processed, which covers the 'thousands of apps via Zapier' part. Its Slack presence is a Fred assistant you tag to answer questions and catch people up; that is not evidence that notes post automatically to channels. Notion is never mentioned. Missing for 10: automatic note delivery to Slack channels, a native Notion integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Zapier flow.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier

citations.quote: Connect Fireflies [webhooks](https://docs.fireflies.ai/graphql-api/webhooks-v2.md) to Zapier to automatically fetch transcripts when meetings are processed.
Tag Fred in Slack. He answers, catches people up, and suggests next steps.
